extracted.name: Basic Cheesecake
extracted.description: This basic cheesecake recipe includes a graham cracker and walnut crust and a thick cheesecake filling with cream cheese, sour cream, and heavy cream.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Combine graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, chopped walnuts, brown sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a bowl; press into the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan.
Bake in the preheated oven for 10 minutes. Remove from the oven; cool.

Beat cream cheese and white sugar together in a large bowl with an electric mixer until smooth. Beat in sour cream and heavy cream; beat in flour and vanilla. Beat in eggs, one at a time, with mixer on low; pour batter over crust.
Bake in the preheated oven until center is almost set (filling will be soft), 60 to 70 minutes. Refrigerate at least 6 hours to overnight before removing from the pan.
